# Stylus Language Bundle

Source: https://github.com/openstyles/stylus-lang-bundle/blob/master/README.md

# Stylus Language Bundle

This repository bundles [Stylus language compiler](https://github.com/stylus/stylus) into a single file that can be used in the browser.

## Live demo

https://raw.githack.com/openstyles/stylus-lang-bundle/master/demo/

## Install

```html
<script src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openstyles/stylus-lang-bundle/refs/tags/v0.64.0/dist/stylus-renderer.min.js"></script>
```

## Usage

```js
var css = stylus(input).render();
console.log(css);
```
